default_comparison.aggregation_method: Median/min/max of JVM p50 values, retaining every trial. Within-JVM p50/p95/p99 use nearest-rank and remain with raw frame samples; frames are never pooled across JVMs. Paired ratios use current/baseline from the same trial, including ratios above one.
default_comparison.phase_method: Measured sample index modulo 2: Gaussian radii 7/11 and bloom iterations 2/3. Phase p50 is nearest-rank within each JVM, then median/min/max across JVMs. Mixed overall distributions are also retained.
default_comparison.timing_gate: None: timings are evidence, not a noisy pass/fail speed threshold
default_comparison.coverage: Pbuffer/FBO, actual shaders/fonts, two viewport/GUI scales; excludes native Display, worlds, shaderpacks and game FPS

first_pair_budget_estimate.scope: Linear planning estimate; excludes CI setup, baseline compilation, current contracts, CPU font probes and artifact upload. Workflow limit remains 25 minutes.
